responsibility: Declares the generic CFG API and the per-function `control_flow_graph` container that stores entry/exit blocks, block tables, label maps, profile status, dominance availability, and dynamically allocated block/edge flag space. It publishes the common CFG construction, edge/block manipulation, dumping, auxiliary-allocation, profile-scaling, and original/copy tracking interfaces from `cfg.cc`, and also defines RAII helpers for reserving temporary edge or block flag bits during analyses and transformations.
same_name_distinction: Defines the public generic CFG interface and core data structures such as control_flow_graph, plus temporary flag-allocation helpers; unlike gcc/cfg.cc, it is the API/structure declaration layer rather than the implementation of CFG manipulation routines.
